descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S17 Nursing Home notes: no signature or date line and no 'yesterday', targeted fixtures plus every Nursing Home note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Nursing Home notes have no signature or date line (PR #57) and never say 'yesterday'. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Three Nursing Home visits that tempt a 'yesterday' (a visit two weeks after the last one, a visit the day after a fall visit, a dictated 'yesterday'), and every Nursing Home note from S12 to S19

When Each targeted fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote; the same checks run on every Nursing Home note of this matrix

Then No signature block, provider line or date line; no 'yesterday' unless the physician dictated it (N-20, recorded only)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustNotInclude and noLineMatches below on every Nursing Home note except N-20, whose 'yesterday' is recorded (Q6). A header date-of-service line is tagged with Q8. On main noteSnfPatientContext never sends previousNotes to the model (they feed only groundingSource for the unit scrub), so the prior-visit facts that tempt a 'yesterday' are given in the background line (fixture ' …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
